title: A sponge draws water
hook: A simple body can maintain a flow.

knows: Animals can have structures and life stages that differ from humans.
doesNotKnow: Arrows show water entering through small side openings and leaving through a larger upper opening. Sponges can filter particles from water; the depiction simplifies their body structure and does not show flow rates or all sponge forms.

misconception: The observations in this scenario require a different interpretation.
objective: A filter-feeding sponge draws water through small openings. Where does water leave in this simplified model?
